resources.string: Allow all rotations - enables 180° in sensor rotation

Makes sensor rotation (auto-rotate / sensor portrait / sensor landscape) also select 180° (upside down). This module simply enables the device\'s \"allow all rotations\" (allowAllRotations) flag in system_server.
Turn off to return to the device default behavior
A reboot is required for changes to take effect. Also make sure \"System Framework (android)\" is enabled in the LSPosed scope.
